name: padecoef
comment: Sig [num,den]=padecoef(T,N): order-N Pade approximant of exp(-T*s). T=2, N=3 -> num=[-1 6 -15 15], den=[1 6 15 15] (den = num with the odd-power signs flipped: same denominator/numerator magnitudes, classic Pade exp structure). Pins BOTH outputs (was out_var dump of num only with den fingerprints that the harness ignored; small N keeps coefficients exactly pinnable).
